rules.then: enforce 30-minute idle timeout — terminate session after inactivity
require multi-factor authentication before granting access
enforce minimum 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol

checks.description: Verify session timeout fires after 30 minutes idle. Test with browser devtools network tab.
Attempt admin panel access without MFA — must be blocked. Document in compliance log.
Run password strength validator against test corpus of 1000 passwords. All must pass.

sections.name: Audit Trail
notes: Each check references its governing rule via target_rule. The reference chain is: check.target_rule → rule.id. This enables automated compliance mapping.

stamps.text: Q1 2026 review: all 3 checks passing. Next review due 2026-04-01.
